posts.title: why'd you go and make it real
posts.description: A bit stressed today. Some Sunday scaries. Maybe writing will calm me down. Life is speeding up it seems like. I think because I am saying yes to things and taking risks. Which is good but also causing a low level of pressure within to perform. I don’t think that is bad but it is a feeling I am feeling. I think I have an idea of what to do but it is not a for sure. I guess the thing is to try; is
